info.name: Flightdeck - dope.security - Public API specification Authorization Endpoints API

params.name: id
params.description: Broad search query across endpoints by device, user and email identities that contain this string (case-insensitive)

params.name: emailId
params.description: Search by email ids that contain this string (case-insensitive)

params.name: deviceName
params.description: Search by device names that contain this string (case-insensitive)

params.name: userId
params.description: Search by user ids that contain this string (case-insensitive). `userId` for OIDC users is usually their email address.

params.name: osVersion
params.description: Filter by this exact device OS version string

params.name: status
params.description: Filter by this exact set of status'

params.name: debugState
params.description:
Filter by this exact set of debug states.
0 means not in debug
1 means debug request sent to endpoint
2 means debug request acknowledged by endpoint

params.name: locationId
params.description: Filter by this exact location id - with an underscore separating the case sensitive city and country values e.g. "City_Country"

params.name: agentVersion
params.description: Filter by this exact agent version

params.name: first
params.description: An optional pagination param that states the number of records requested from the **start** of the `cursor`. The default value is **50**.

params.name: after
params.description: An optional pagination cursor. Pass the `endCursor` from the previous response's `pageInfo` to fetch the next page. Check `hasNextPage` in the previous response's `pageInfo` to determine whether more records are available.

params.name: order
params.description: The direction of the sort by the `lastSeen` property. The default is to sort by descending

items.docs:
Use this API to get a list of all endpoints, or search for those matching a query parameter.

Note:
- To return a list of all endpoints do not include any additional parameter.
- Only one of the optional parameters is allowed to be specified per request.
- Results are returned in pages using cursor based pagination and ordered by the `lastSeen` property.
